axes.model_access: Self-developed MetaLLM large language model (the official about-us page states the in-house narrative explicitly) — a rare self-developed route among AI search products; which model version each feature calls is not disclosed item by item on the official site (no guessing).
axes.runtime: Web (metaso.cn) + App/mini-program (seen on the official site); retrieval and generation on the vendor's cloud; direct connection from mainland China works.
axes.local_files: History/bookshelf stored on the account-side cloud; exports (Word/PDF) count as local. No other local data surfaces officially stated seen.
axes.background: Three intensity tiers (concise/deep/deep-research, official product surface); deep research is a multi-line follow-up-search task line; no "keep-running-after-shutdown" concept.
axes.tools: Six-way retrieval (web/libraries/academic/images/videos/podcasts, official product surface), sectioned answers + source markers, outline/mind-map generation, an academic tier with subdivisions (Chinese library/English library/PubMed/zone filtering, seen on the official site), slides/interactive-webpage generation, a fact-checking entry, open API.
axes.context: Retrieval records organized via history/bookshelf; cross-session memory not verified to an official statement (not verified item by item).
axes.permissions: Account + membership/credits system (D9: pricing not collected); the training-use switch not verified item by item. Filing: MetaLLM filing no. Shanghai-MetaLLM-20231106 (CAC April-2024 filing-summary attachment, direct-fetched and verified 2026-10-22); the algorithm filing "MetaLLM大语言模型文本生成算法" covers Metaso AI Search across surfaces (CAC August-2023 algorithm list, direct fetch) — two numbering systems, don't cross-quote.
axes.fit: Fits: deep retrieval of Chinese materials (no ads, straight to results), academic Chinese-library retrieval, wanting outline/mind-map structured output, mainland direct connection. Does not fit: English-first global retrieval, treating AI answers as source-free conclusions (the markers must be opened and checked against the original).

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creation products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Deep-research tier's multi-line follow-up search vs Perplexity Deep Research quality**
- **Recall completeness of the academic tier's PubMed/zone filtering**
- **Transparency of the fact-checking entry's judgment logic**
unknowns:

related: English-leaning counterpart: Perplexity needs a network path, Metaso connects directly from China + has deep Chinese libraries.
Complementary form: Metaso helps you find sources, NotebookLM digs deep inside the sources you give it.
Also domestic AI search: Devv is developer-oriented (code docs), Metaso is general + academic.
